description: Implementation of database management functions for UCI sections in the prplMesh project, including adding, setting, retrieving, and removing entries, as well as committing changes.

methods.name: db_has_entry
methods.description: Checks if a specific entry exists in the database.

methods.name: db_add_entry
methods.description: Adds a new entry to the database with specified parameters.

methods.name: db_set_entry
methods.description: Updates an existing database entry with new parameters.

methods.name: db_get_entry
methods.description: Retrieves parameters of a specific database entry.

methods.name: db_get_entries_by_type
methods.description: Retrieves all entries of a specific type from the database.

methods.name: db_remove_entry
methods.description: Removes a specific entry from the database.

methods.name: db_commit_changes
methods.description: Commits all pending changes to the database.
